instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Strato is a mental health tech company offering an app-based cognitive behavioral therapy program with human therapist chat support, focusing on scalable, personalized interventions for anxiety and depression. With 18,000 active users and strong clinical evidence (RCT data), the company is strategically pivoting toward B2B corporate wellness programs and actively exploring generative AI models to enhance therapist efficiency and patient engagement. This growth trajectory positions Strato as a key player in integrating digital therapeutics into traditional healthcare ecosystems.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful for optimizing therapist scheduling efficiency. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan, leading to a knowledge silo and eventual obsolescence when the engineer left. This experience highlighted that good ideas require formal ownership and established technical roadmaps to survive in a structured environment.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.additionalContext: Strato is currently navigating complex HIPAA compliance requirements across different international markets, which adds significant friction to rapid product expansion. Furthermore, the company's current reliance on external vendor APIs poses a dependency risk that could impact system stability and long-term integration efforts.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Therapeutic Productivity Platform (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing R&D focus on AI tools to create a specialized platform that automates administrative tasks for human therapists. This could drastically reduce operational costs and allow Strato to scale its service offering globally without proportional staffing increases.

first_actions: Form cross-functional task force (R&D, Engineering, Clinical Ops) dedicated solely to AI feasibility study.
Conduct a proof-of-concept POC on integrating LLMs into scheduling and progress note summarization.
resources_needed: Budget allocation of $150k for API access and initial modeling costs
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average therapist administrative time by 30% within 12 months.
milestones: Q4: Pilot integration with 5 partner clinics

opportunities.title: Corporate Wellness B2B Expansion
opportunities.rationale: Systematically package the existing CBT program into customized corporate wellness subscriptions targeting specific industries (e.g., tech, finance). This leverages current clinical success to enter a high-value market segment that requires tailored, scalable solutions.

first_actions: Develop a standardized B2B offering framework and pricing model.
Identify 5 key enterprise clients in the target sector for pilot programs.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve $100k in recurring B2B subscription revenue within 9 months.
milestones: Q4: Finalize legal contracts and pricing structure
Q1: Launch pilot program with first enterprise client

next_steps.action: Formalize and institutionalize the innovation process by establishing a dedicated 'Innovation Steering Committee' with budget authority.
Initiate discovery phase for AI productivity tools, defining technical requirements and securing initial specialized talent recruitment pipeline.
Conduct a market sizing study focusing on adjacent mental health tech niches suitable for M&A diversification platforms.

key_weaknesses: Informal innovation process leading to inconsistent idea execution and poor knowledge retention.
Current reliance on highly constrained budget (6%) which limits investment in necessary R&D talent for radical projects.
High dependency risk on external vendor APIs, potentially limiting long-term customization and scalability.
